body.description: Vendlet: a squat vending machine creature, tall red body, the lit glass front shows rows of cans like teeth, coin slot eyes, the delivery flap as a mouth, heavy stomping legs, holds a grudge. a small living machine creature (an Ohm), an old household or farm machine that woke up with a will of its own, weathered by years outdoors, no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
